title: Plugin Manifest
description: Manifest describing an AhaSlides slide plugin.

$schema.description: URL of this manifest's JSON Schema, used by editors for autocompletion and validation.

name.description: Human-readable plugin name shown in the UI.

icon.description: Absolute or relative path to the plugin icon asset.

baseUrl.description: Base URL where the plugin is hosted. Supports `{{VAR}}` template placeholders resolved at runtime.

staticTabs.description: Tabs registered by the plugin at fixed contexts.

contentUrl.description: URL path (relative to `baseUrl`) rendered inside the tab.

context.description: Where this tab is shown inside the host app.

name.description: Optional display name for the tab.
